title: Handle a terminating error
summary: PowerShell: Handle a terminating error. Change the message in catch.
introduction: try and catch handle a terminating error. throw creates one here.
learningObjectives: Handle a terminating error with PowerShell

blocks.text: Open PowerShell 7. Paste one example or save it as lesson.ps1 and run pwsh -NoProfile -File lesson.ps1. No administrator access is needed.

blocks.title: Handle a terminating error
blocks.code: try { throw "Missing score" } catch { Write-Output "Try again" }

blocks.text: throw creates a terminating error. catch responds with the friendly text.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Many command errors need -ErrorAction Stop to be caught by try/catch.

seo.description: PowerShell: Handle a terminating error. Change the message in catch. Follow a small example and practise the idea.
